[P2] Track result handoff separately for each invoked execution

Pending work in any other child bypasses this handoff guard. Consider parallel branches where A invokes a child that waits one hour, then waits another hour itself, while B invokes a child that waits three hours. When A's child finishes, B keeps `invokedWorkRemains` true, allowing the clock to jump to hour three before A's result reaches its caller. A's subsequent wait therefore finishes at hour four, extending a workflow that should finish at hour three. Keep each child's completion handoff busy until its caller's continuation is queued, regardless of other participants' pending work, and add a regression covering these two concurrent invokes.
